title: Why MSCI’s Upcoming Decision on Bitcoin Treasury Companies Matters
summary: Bitcoin MagazineWhy MSCI’s Upcoming Decision on Bitcoin Treasury Companies MattersIndex giant MSCI announces its decision January 15 on excluding companies with over 50% digital assets, including Bitcoin holders MicroStrategy and Metaplanet, potentially triggering $10-15B in forced sales and reshaping corporate Bitcoin strategies.This postWhy MSCI’s Upcoming Decision on Bitcoin Treasury Companies Mattersfirst appeared onBitcoin Magazineand is written byJuan Galt.
